opportunities.name: Cadence Target Cycle
opportunities.objective: Compare fresh-target cadence attacks with repeated locked-target attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: P gives current-health physical damage with a per-target cooldown. Q armor reduction helps the next attack; E grants attack speed and Trinity/Sundered Sky reward an actual fresh-target attack. Stridebreaker aids moving among targets rather than repeatedly hitting a P-locked opponent.
opportunities.requiredState: Two reachable targets with separate P cooldowns and Q applied first.
opportunities.failure: Target switching loses focus damage or exposes Jarvan to both enemies.
opportunities.test: Compare fresh-target cadence attacks with repeated locked-target attacks; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Attack speed does not remove the per-target passive cooldown.

opportunities.name: Flag Magic Ally Lock
opportunities.objective: Measure E impact and allied attack uptime during flag plus cage.
opportunities.mechanic: E has 0.8 AP magic damage while granting allied attack speed for eight seconds. AP/haste flags plus E-Q knockup can trigger Mandate for allies; R terrain can keep enemies in reach. Cosmic follows E magic damage and Cryptbloom rewards allies completing the catch.
opportunities.requiredState: Flag hits a champion with allies using the aura; E-Q knockup connects.
opportunities.failure: AP sacrifices Q/R physical damage and the target dashes out of R.
opportunities.test: Measure E impact and allied attack uptime during flag plus cage; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The flag attack-speed aura is not a heal or shield trigger.

ruledOut.reason: R lists AD physical scaling, unlike E's AP magic packet.

unknowns: Q/W/R AD statFormula basis needs checking; allied aura must not be assumed to activate enchantment healing items.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.name: Cadence Target Cycle
builds.summary: Compare fresh-target cadence attacks with repeated locked-target attacks.
builds.goal: Compare fresh-target cadence attacks with repeated locked-target attacks.
builds.hypothesis: P gives current-health physical damage with a per-target cooldown. Q armor reduction helps the next attack; E grants attack speed and Trinity/Sundered Sky reward an actual fresh-target attack. Stridebreaker aids moving among targets rather than repeatedly hitting a P-locked opponent.
testPlan: Required state: Two reachable targets with separate P cooldowns and Q applied first.
Compare fresh-target cadence attacks with repeated locked-target attacks; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Target switching loses focus damage or exposes Jarvan to both enemies.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Attack speed does not remove the per-target passive cooldown.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Sundered Sky, Stridebreaker, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
